verses.en: Bel boweth down, Nebo stoopeth, their idols were upon the beasts, and upon the cattle: your carriages were heavy loaden; they are a burden to the weary beast.
verses.pt: Bel se abaixa, Nebo se curva; seus ídolos são postos sobre os animais e sobre o gado; as cargas de vossos fardos são exaustivas para os animais já cansados.
verses.en_web: Bel bows down. Nebo stoops. Their idols are carried by animals, and on the livestock. The things that you carried around are heavy loads, a burden for the weary.
verses.en_bbe: Bel is bent down, Nebo is falling; their images are on the beasts and on the cattle: the things which you took about have become a weight to the tired beast.

verses.en: They stoop, they bow down together; they could not deliver the burden, but themselves are gone into captivity.
verses.pt: Juntamente se encurvam e se abaixam; não podem salvar a carga, mas eles mesmos vão ao cativeiro.
verses.en_web: They stoop and they bow down together. They could not deliver the burden, but they have gone into captivity.
verses.en_bbe: They are bent down, they are falling together: they were not able to keep their images safe, but they themselves have been taken prisoner.

verses.en: Hearken unto me, O house of Jacob, and all the remnant of the house of Israel, which are borne by me from the belly, which are carried from the womb:
verses.pt: Ouvi-me, ó casa de Jacó, e todo o restante da casa de Israel; vós a quem eu carreguei desde o ventre, a quem levei desde o útero.
verses.en_web: “Listen to me, house of Jacob, and all the remnant of the house of Israel, that have been carried from their birth, that have been carried from the womb.
verses.en_bbe: Give ear to me, O family of Jacob, and all the rest of the people of Israel, who have been supported by me from their birth, and have been my care from their earliest days:

verses.en: And even to your old age I am he; and even to hoar hairs will I carry you: I have made, and I will bear; even I will carry, and will deliver you.
verses.pt: E até vossa velhice eu serei o mesmo, e ainda até à idade dos cabelos grisalhos eu vos carregarei; eu vos fiz, e eu vos levarei; eu vos carregarei e vos livrarei.
verses.en_web: Even to old age I am he, and even to gray hairs I will carry you. I have made, and I will bear. Yes, I will carry, and will deliver.
verses.en_bbe: Even when you are old I will be the same, and when you are grey-haired I will take care of you: I will still be responsible for what I made; yes, I will take you and keep you safe.

verses.en: To whom will ye liken me, and make me equal, and compare me, that we may be like?
verses.pt: A quem me considerareis semelhante, e com quem me igualareis, e me comparareis, para que sejamos semelhantes?
verses.en_web: “To whom will you compare me, and consider my equal, and compare me, as if we were the same?
verses.en_bbe: Who in your eyes is my equal? or what comparison will you make with me?

verses.en: They lavish gold out of the bag, and weigh silver in the balance, and hire a goldsmith; and he maketh it a god: they fall down, yea, they worship.
verses.pt: Eles gastam o ouro da bolsa, e pesam a prata com balanças; pagam ao ourives, e daquilo ele faz um deus, e se prostram e adoram.
verses.en_web: Some pour out gold from the bag, and weigh silver in the balance. They hire a goldsmith, and he makes it a god. They fall down— yes, they worship.
verses.en_bbe: As for those who take gold out of a bag, and put silver in the scales, they give payment to a gold-worker, to make it into a god; they go down on their faces and give it worship.

verses.en: They bear him upon the shoulder, they carry him, and set him in his place, and he standeth; from his place shall he not remove: yea, one shall cry unto him, yet can he not answer, nor save him out of his trouble.
verses.pt: Sobre os ombros o temam, o carregam, e o põem em seu lugar; ali ele fica, de seu lugar não se move; e se chamarem por ele, resposta nenhuma ele dá, nem o livra de sua aflição.
verses.en_web: They bear it on their shoulder. They carry it, and set it in its place, and it stands there. It cannot move from its place. Yes, one may cry to it, yet it can not answer. It cannot save him out of his trouble.
verses.en_bbe: They put him on their backs, and take him up, and put him in his fixed place, from which he may not be moved; if a man gives a cry for help to him, he is unable to give an answer, or get him out of his trouble.

verses.en: Remember this, and shew yourselves men: bring it again to mind, O ye transgressors.
verses.pt: Lembrai-vos disto, e sede corajosos; fazei memória disso no coração, ó transgressores!
verses.en_web: “Remember this, and show yourselves men. Bring it to mind again, you transgressors.
verses.en_bbe: Keep this in mind and be shamed; let it come back to your memory, you sinners.

verses.en: Remember the former things of old: for I am God, and there is none else; I am God, and there is none like me,
verses.pt: Lembrai-vos das coisas passadas desde a antiguidade; porque eu sou Deus, e nenhum outro deus há, e ninguém há semelhante a mim,
verses.en_web: Remember the former things of old: for I am God, and there is no other. I am God, and there is none like me.
verses.en_bbe: Let the things which are past come to your memory: for I am God, and there is no other; I am God, and there is no one like me;

verses.en: Declaring the end from the beginning, and from ancient times the things that are not yet done, saying, My counsel shall stand, and I will do all my pleasure:
verses.pt: Que declaro o fim desde o princípio, e desde a antiguidade as coisas que ainda não aconteceram; que digo: Minha intenção será firme, e farei toda a minha vontade.
verses.en_web: I declare the end from the beginning, and from ancient times things that are not yet done. I say: My counsel will stand, and I will do all that I please.
verses.en_bbe: Making clear from the first what is to come, and from past times the things which have not so far come about; saying, My purpose is fixed, and I will do all my pleasure;

verses.en: Calling a ravenous bird from the east, the man that executeth my counsel from a far country: yea, I have spoken it, I will also bring it to pass; I have purposed it, I will also do it.
verses.pt: Que chamo a ave de rapina desde o oriente, ao homem da minha intenção desde as terras distantes; porque assim disse; e assim o cumprirei; eu o formei, também o farei.
verses.en_web: I call a ravenous bird from the east, the man of my counsel from a far country. Yes, I have spoken. I will also bring it to pass. I have planned. I will also do it.
verses.en_bbe: Sending for a bird of strong flight from the east, the man of my purpose from a far country; I have said it, and I will give effect to it; the thing designed by me will certainly be done.

verses.en: Hearken unto me, ye stouthearted, that are far from righteousness:
verses.pt: Ouvi-me, ó duros de coração; vós que estais longe da justiça:
verses.en_web: Listen to me, you stubborn-hearted, who are far from righteousness!
verses.en_bbe: Give ear to me, you feeble-hearted, who have no faith in my righteousness:

verses.en: I bring near my righteousness; it shall not be far off, and my salvation shall not tarry: and I will place salvation in Zion for Israel my glory.
verses.pt: Eu trago para perto minha justiça, ela não ficará longe; e minha salvação não tardará; mas porei salvação em Sião, a Israel minha glória.
verses.en_web: I bring my righteousness near. It is not far off, and my salvation will not wait. I will grant salvation to Zion, my glory to Israel.
verses.en_bbe: My righteousness is near, it is not far off; salvation will come quickly; and I will make Zion free, and give Israel my glory.
